decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost part of the core thermoforming consumables range, so with no evident shortfall against aspiration there is little trigger for search, though their absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some uncertainty.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a staple material for dental laboratories and fits the established business, so keeping it remains the satisficing choice despite reduced web visibility.
The UV-curing lacquer was only ever mentioned and has not been seen since, which raises the risk it underperforms, but as a cheap complementary consumable the large firm's slack can still carry it.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the strategic move into digital scanning workflows, which justifies tolerating uncertain results, although missing web presence suggests weak traction.

Custom earmolds belong to the skilled custom-device base for hearing-care retailers, and the earlier withdrawal of the related hearing-protection line already freed resources, so there is no strong pressure to cut this line too.
